honesty_help.basis_real_pre_tax_no_subsidy: Money is in real terms, before tax and without subsidy, in the currency year stated beside each figure.
honesty_help.battery_fom_on_inverter_investment_only: The battery's fixed operating cost is charged on the inverter investment only.
honesty_help.battery_upfront_from_ledger_not_back_cal: The battery's purchase cost comes from the assumptions ledger; other screens that back-calculate it from an annualised cost show a different upfront figure.
honesty_help.battery_value_is_the_option_value: For a battery-only option the battery's value is the option's value.
honesty_help.currency_year_stated: Every money figure states the currency year it is expressed in.
honesty_help.demand_charge_perfect_foresight: The demand-charge saving assumes the battery knows every month's peak in advance; a real controller misses some peaks, so this stream is an upper bound.
honesty_help.duals_include_demand_charge: The model's energy prices include the demand charge's shadow price, so they are not market prices.
honesty_help.inverter_replaced_at_its_lifetime: The inverter is replaced at the end of its own lifetime, inside the horizon.
honesty_help.irr_and_discounted_payback_bounded_at_op: For the same reason the IRR is at least the discount rate and the discounted payback is within the horizon; the magnitudes inform, the bounds do not.
honesty_help.lcos_excludes_charging_energy_cost: The pro forma's levelised cost of storage leaves out the energy bought to charge the battery.
honesty_help.lcos_two_definitions: Two levelised costs of storage are shown and they answer different questions: the pro forma's excludes the energy bought to charge the battery, asset economics' includes it.
honesty_help.market_revenue_at_duals_excluded_from_ca: Revenue at the model's prices is reported beside the case and excluded from the cash flow: the bill already prices the same energy.
honesty_help.market_revenue_at_duals_zero_profit_at_o: The revenue at the model's prices equals the battery's annualised cost at the optimum: zero profit by construction. It is not a second revenue line and is excluded from the cash flow.
honesty_help.npv_nonnegative_at_optimum_by_constructi: At the optimiser's chosen size the NPV cannot be negative: the optimiser only builds what pays for itself, so the sign restates its choice and is not independent evidence.
honesty_help.perfect_foresight_dispatch: The model dispatches the battery knowing the whole year's load and prices in advance; a real controller will capture less.
honesty_help.question_has_no_reliability_part: This question does not ask about reliability or resilience.
honesty_help.salvage_annuity_pv_remaining_life: Equipment with life left at the end of the horizon is credited with the present value of the annuities the model charged for that remaining life.
honesty_help.single_year_extrapolated: One representative year of operation is repeated over the whole horizon.
honesty_help.synthetic_load_profile: The load is a synthetic sector profile, not the site's metered load.
honesty_help.synthetic_load_understates_peak_shaving: A smooth synthetic load lacks the short spikes a real meter records, so the peak-shaving value is likely understated; upload the site's metered load.
honesty_help.tariff_illustrative: The tariff is illustrative, not a published tariff.
honesty_help.technology_costs_are_projections: The technology costs are projections for a future year.
honesty_help.tornado_method_redispatch_fixed_sizes: The tornado holds the recommended sizes fixed and re-dispatches them at each driver's low and high value, so a bar can turn negative.
honesty_help.typical_week_not_in_mvp1: The typical-week operating chart is not part of this version.

question_title: Do I need a battery at my site, and what is it worth?

required_disclosures.text: At the optimiser's chosen size the NPV cannot be negative: the optimiser only builds what pays for itself, so the sign restates its choice and is not independent evidence.
For the same reason the IRR is at least the discount rate and the discounted payback is within the horizon; the magnitudes inform, the bounds do not.
Money is in real terms, before tax and without subsidy, in the currency year stated beside each figure.
One representative year of operation is repeated over the whole horizon.
The model dispatches the battery knowing the whole year's load and prices in advance; a real controller will capture less.
The revenue at the model's prices equals the battery's annualised cost at the optimum: zero profit by construction. It is not a second revenue line and is excluded from the cash flow.
Two levelised costs of storage are shown and they answer different questions: the pro forma's excludes the energy bought to charge the battery, asset economics' includes it.
The demand-charge saving assumes the battery knows every month's peak in advance; a real controller misses some peaks, so this stream is an upper bound.
A smooth synthetic load lacks the short spikes a real meter records, so the peak-shaving value is likely understated; upload the site's metered load.
The tariff is illustrative, not a published tariff.
